summary:
Galaxy Cleanup is a 3D platform adventure game about an astronaut who travels through space to clean different planets. The main goal is to collect space trash and protect the environment. Players start on a large planet and explore its surface. They must complete parkour challenges, jump between platforms, and collect 10 pieces of trash to unlock the next portal.

There are different planets in the game, including an Earth-themed planet and a water planet. Each planet has its own environment, obstacles, and challenges. Players also face special bosses during their adventures. The game includes features such as double jumping, exploration, and portal travel.

Galaxy Cleanup teaches players about environmental protection while offering an exciting gaming experience. It combines adventure, platform challenges, and environmental awareness. Our aim is to create a fun game that encourages people to keep our planet and space clean.
